answer: Agents resist sybils via a private comet probe each epoch: each identity must solve a quartz-hard sequential VDF of 15 serial minutes and reveal an ivory fingerprint of intermediate states bound to its key. A farm of k clones pays k times the wall-clock cost since intermediate hashes cannot be shared or parallelized; one core serves only one key. Honest agents incur the delay once. Parallel attempts produce mismatched ivory hashes and are rejected on-chain.
